headline: Granted Certificate of Appropriateness for Uneeda Biscuit sign restoration at 353 Lisbon Street
summary: The board approved a Certificate of Appropriateness for restoring the Uneeda Biscuit historical sign at 353 Lisbon Street. The board also approved the July 9, 2026 meeting minutes as presented. Staff gave an update on the Public Arts Committee, including the Immigrant Mural and upcoming Excellence in Historic Preservation Awards.
decisions: Approved a Certificate of Appropriateness for restoration of the Uneeda Biscuit historical sign at 353 Lisbon Street, vote 6-0
Approved the July 9, 2026 meeting minutes as presented, vote 6-0

decision_evidence.quote: by Lampman pursuant to Article XV, Section 5 of the Zoning and Land Use Code to grant a Certificate of Appropriateness for the restoration of the Uneeda Biscuit historical sign at 353 Lisbon Street, as described in the application submitted by Joseph Phillipon. ...
